messages:
alex.sre: FYI SLO alert fired for ingress gateway p99 timeout in euw1, customer support pointing to a cluster of 502/504s from hosted API. Not obvious correlating deploy.

sam.support: saw 3 customer tickets in the last 10m reporting timeouts/5xx when hitting /v1/generate, all from same org id. forwarded logs attached. :frowning:

maria.obs: grabbing dashboards. initial look: traffic normal but a tail spike in connection resets and handshake timeouts around 11:03-11:07. Prefetch latency jumps too. :eyes:

alex.sre: tagging @jess.platform for any recent infra pushes. deploy-bot: can you confirm if any rolling restarts or config changes hit the gateway between 10:50-11:10?

deploy-bot: No automated deploys in that window. A maintenance job in usw2 touched cert rotation earlier but nothing in euw1.

jess.platform: no code deploys in euw1. we did roll a sidecar config change to Batcher v2 in staging 10:40, not prod.

maria.obs: adding quick queries: logs show many upstream ECONNRESET and TLS handshake timeouts to kv-cache-backend-1. Query: 
```
service:ingress-gateway env:euw1 level>=error | json | where status_code in (502,504) | count by upstream_host, message
```
Results: bulk of 502s attributed to upstream kv-cache-backend-1.euw1.internal.

alex.sre: Interesting — could be cache backend degrading and causing pipeline backlog -> client timeouts. Any recent scale or health events for kv-cache?

maria.obs: health checks for kv-cache show intermittent 5xx responses ~11:02-11:06 and a few instance restarts in autoscaler logs. attaching snippet: `autoscaler: restarted instance kv-3 (OOMKill) at 11:04)`

sam.support: customers say errors were transient but hit production traffic. They want repro steps. I can ask them for example request IDs. I have two: req_8a3f and req_b7c2.

maria.obs: traced req_8a3f: trace shows ingress -> batcher -> kv-cache call then a 502 propagate. But traces are incomplete around the kv-cache call (gap between batcher exit and kv-cache entry). looks like sampling missed spans during the outage window.

alex.sre: trace gap + autoscaler restarts points to backend flapping. Immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic away from kv-cache-backend-1 pool (circuit) 2) increase replica targets for kv-cache 3) enable immediate fallback to cold-store read path for reads. Thoughts?

jess.platform: we can flip routing for 2m to avoid the node pool, need oncall approval. Also can temporarily bump kv-cache min replicas by +2 but that will take ~90s to spin.

sam.support: I'll tell customers we're investigating and will attempt a short failover. Ask: do we expect data loss?

maria.obs: no data loss expected, just increased latency for cache misses. I'll run a synthetic probe to validate fallback path: `curl -sS https://euw1-hosted-api/check?probe=cache-fallback` and monitor traces.

alex.sre: go for routing flip first, maria please run probe and post results. Jess, please push the routing change if probe fails. Also create a dashboard slice for request IDs sample: `trace_id:req_8a3f` and share link.

maria.obs: probe response: 200 but fallback path latency 600ms (ok). synthetic checks show no 502 after routing to fallback for 5m.

jess.platform: routing flip scheduled, flipping now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: routing-change completed: traffic pool switched away from kv-cache-backend-1 at 11:12:45.

alex.sre: monitoring SLO and customer tickets. will keep this thread for followup and RCA once we have autoscaler logs and kernel OOM traces from kv instances.

sam.support: updated customers with mitigation and ETA for RCA (~4 hours).

maria.obs: collecting logs: kernel messages show memory pressure and OOMKill on kv-3, container restarted twice in the window. hypothesis: memory leak in latest runtime or unexpected workload spike.

jess.platform: I'll schedule a canary rolling update to kv-cache image with older runtime for repro. No immediate promo to prod until RCA.

alex.sre: thanks team. follow-ups: (1) RCA doc link will be posted here, (2) create alert for autoscaler restart bursts (threshold >2 in 5m), (3) add tracer sampling override for cache-backend errors during SLO burn windows.

maria.obs: created ticket INF-4627 for autoscaler restart alert and INF-4628 for sampling override.

sam.support: closing loop with customers, will reopen if they see more errors. :thumbsup:

alex.sre: thread summary: transient kv-cache instance OOM -> autoscaler restarts -> trace sampling gaps -> upstream 502s to gateway -> SLO alert. mitigated by routing away from affected pool and fallback to cold store. RCA in progress.
__notes: generated thread conforms to agents.md: messages are a single continuous string; required metadata fields present.
